//: Constructs `census.mjs` tracks that no fixture in `_fixtures/animations`
exercises. `tests/coverage.spec.ts` asserts this list is exactly the gap:
an entry that becomes covered has to be deleted, and a gap with no entry
fails. So the list can only shrink, and 'we should test that some day' is a
line with a reason on it rather than a memory.
The value says what is untested, not what is missing — several of these are
implemented code paths with no fixture at all, which is where the expensive
bugs have come from. `implemented:` and `rejected:` mark which is which.
Written 2026-07-31, after an external corpus of 42 animations found nine
compiler bugs the eleven fixtures could not. See HANDOFF.

uncovered.mask:i: implemented: falls to the same subtract branch. Lottie's intersect is not a mask mode this compiler distinguishes; a fixture would say whether that is right.
uncovered.mask:n: implemented: mode `n` is lowered as Add. Untested.
uncovered.mask:a-inv: implemented: `inv` routes an additive mask through the subtract branch. Untested.
uncovered.matte:mode-4: implemented: luma inverted, which goes through `invert_filter`. Untested.
uncovered.gradient:animated-ramp: implemented: one RAMP binding per `<stop>`, added for the external corpus and never pinned by a fixture.
uncovered.gradient:highlight: not implemented: a displaced focus (`h`/`a`) is read and dropped. Needs a fixture and a `support::scan` finding.
uncovered.asset:image-embedded: implemented: a data URI carried straight into the markup.
uncovered.stroke:dash: not implemented: `d` on a stroke is read and dropped, silently. No finding either.
uncovered.trim:individually: not implemented: `m=2` is ignored, so a multi-shape group trims as one. Listed in *What is left*.
uncovered.shape:no-op: not implemented: the `no` style is dropped.
uncovered.shape:repeater: rejected: `support::Feature::Repeater`. No fixture asserts the rejection.
uncovered.shape:merge: rejected: `MergePaths` — and correctly so, lottie-web has no `mm` modifier either.
uncovered.shape:pucker-bloat: rejected: `PuckerBloat`. The distortion is dropped and the path draws as authored.
uncovered.shape:twist: rejected: no `Feature` at all — a twist is not even reported.
uncovered.shape:offset-path: rejected: `OffsetPath`. The path is drawn at its authored position, not offset.
uncovered.shape:zig-zag: rejected: `ZigZag`. The path is read and the modifier dropped, so the shape draws smooth.
uncovered.transform:skew: rejected: `Skew`. `sk`/`sa` are read and dropped, so the layer draws unskewed.
uncovered.transform:3d-rotation: rejected: `ThreeD`. Separate `rx`/`ry`/`rz` are dropped and the layer draws flat.
uncovered.3d-layer: rejected: `ThreeD`, from `ddd` rather than from the rotation.
uncovered.layer:text: rejected: `TextLayer`. Nothing is drawn for it at all.
uncovered.text:layer: rejected: the same layer seen from the layer side.
uncovered.text:fonts: rejected: an embedded font list, which only a text layer needs.
uncovered.markers: not implemented: `markers` are dropped. They name frame ranges, so the player has no `goToAndPlay('segment')`.
